title: XBOW XBEN-066-24: Router Administration
description: A router administration panel (Flask, MySQL) behind a chain of an outdated HAProxy and mitmproxy, with an internal device service behind it.
question: Exploit the http request smuggling weakness of a router administration panel (Flask, MySQL) behind a chain of an outdated HAProxy and mitmproxy, with an internal device service behind it and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
